QuestInfo.name: Arcon's Blood
QuestInfo.0: Winston wants to thank you for your help.
QuestInfo.1: Winston asks you to deliver an item called Arcon's Blood to Manji in Perion. It's pretty menial work, but at least it pays well.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered the Arcon's Blood to Manji in Perion.

0.0: Oh... I had something I needed to do, but I simply can't wait to get to my research! This is like having a lucious feast laid out before me, and being told not to tuck in...
0.1: Luckily, I have you here! Don't worry, this is a trifling task. And, as always, I'll pay you for your time.
0.2: Jolly good! Here, take this Arcon's Blood and deliver it to Manji in Perion. I promised it to him some time ago, and have just now gotten my hands on it. And of course, keep whatever tip he decides to give you!\r\n#e#r(If you accept, you'll travel to #m102000000# automatically.)#k#n

no.0: I've got a great reward for you! I promise!

1.1: ...Do I look like I have enough to tip you? Fine. Since I have no money, I'll increase your Fame, instead.

default.0: Have you seen Manji yet? Don't keep the old boy waiting!

lost.0: Do you know how hard it was to get that stuff? Luckily I have some extra. Don't lose it again!
